allow: PowerShell(@\('backend','ml-service','frontend'\) | ForEach-Object { $dir = $_; Get-ChildItem $dir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $size = \(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{ Path = "$dir/$\($_.Name\)"; SizeMB = [math]::Round\($size / 1MB, 2\) } } } | Sort-Object SizeMB -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 | Format-Table -AutoSize)
